name: Fireball
description:
Uncheck any number of Conditions.

Choose a point within long range. An explosive sphere of fire erupts at that point. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against each creature within short range of the point. On a win, the creature takes 2d6 damage for each Condition you unchecked (3d6 for Anger). On a loss, half damage.

Describe the fireball.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: The blast instead reaches out to medium range.
